scope: 60 intents (88 distinct images) inspected before retrieval evaluation, including 12 seeded fresh-photo targets and multi-positive report/workflow queries. Same-split negatives describe distinct inspected required content; ambiguous intent pairs remain unjudged. Agent review and translations, without independent human/native-speaker review or exhaustive corpus judgments. Legacy targets were used in prior pipeline development; new-scale targets are reported separately.
